entities.name: Stanisław Stroński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Stroński was a Polish philologist, publicist and politician. In interwar Poland he edited the Rzeczpospolita newspaper and was a professor at Kraków's Jagiellonian University and at the Catholic University of Lublin. During World War II he was a member of the Polish government in exile, serving as information minister. At war's end, he remained abroad.
